confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors use 2026 Numbeo, Hikersbay, Bodrum guide and Turkey-wide bar-survey data, with TRY converted at about 49.5 per USD. Most of it is late-2026 snapshots rather than July. Beer assumes a 50cl draft. Beer, coffee and meals are medium confidence. Cocktail and wine are lower because they blend Bodrum venue ranges with national medians and are cross-checked against the beer relationship. Accommodation is a general-knowledge July peak-season estimate, not checked against live listings (low confidence). FX was not read directly from the RBA table: 0.6976 is a secondhand report of the RBA 4pm reading for 2026-11-03, so it is not the latest observation. Verify against the RBA F11.1 series before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No other city used. Food and drink rest mainly on Bodrum-specific data backed by Turkey-wide 2026 data. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of Aegean July peak rates. Region is Middle East because Bodrum sits on Turkey's Anatolian coast and Turkey is grouped with Western Asia.
